structureTips.title: Misol keltir
structureTips.detail: Uy hayvonini parvarishlashni "For example..." deb misol bilan tushuntir.

structureTips.title: Fikr bildir
structureTips.detail: Javobingni "I think..." deb orzuingdagi uy hayvoni haqida boshla.

structureTips.title: Boshqalar fikri
structureTips.detail: Odamlar nega mushuklarni tanlashini "Some people think..." deb ayt.

structureTips.title: Xulosa qil
structureTips.detail: Oxirida "Overall..." deb sodiq do'sting haqida qisqa xulosa qil.

dialogs.title: New Friend at School
dialogs.intro: Hi! I'm Alex. I'm new at this school. Nice to meet you!

turns.characterLine: What games do you usually play on the playground?
turns.studentHint: Alex'ga qanday o'yinlar o'ynashingizni ayting.

turns.characterLine: That sounds fun! Can you show me how to play hopscotch?
turns.studentHint: Klass o'yinini qanday o'ynashni tushuntiring.

turns.characterLine: Great! Where can we find something to eat at break time?
turns.studentHint: Maktab oshxonasi haqida ayting.

turns.characterLine: Thank you for helping me. Will you be my friend?
turns.studentHint: Alex'ning savoliga xushmuomalalik bilan javob bering.

dialogs.title: At the Electronics Store
dialogs.intro: Welcome to our electronics store! How can I help you today?

turns.characterLine: We have many gadgets. What are you looking for?
turns.studentHint: Qaysi gadjetni sotib olmoqchi ekaningizni ayting.

turns.characterLine: Good choice! What features are important for you?
turns.studentHint: Sizga muhim bo'lgan xususiyatlarni tasvirlang.

turns.characterLine: This model costs 200 dollars. Would you like to buy it?
turns.studentHint: Narx haqida savol bering yoki qaror qiling.

turns.characterLine: Thank you for your purchase! Have a nice day!
turns.studentHint: Sotuvchiga rahmat ayting va xayrlashing.

dialogs.title: At the Doctor's Office
dialogs.intro: Hello! I am Doctor Jasur. Please come in and sit down.

turns.characterLine: Hello! How are you feeling today?
turns.studentHint: Shifokorga salom bering va o'zingizni yomon his qilayotganingizni ayting.

turns.characterLine: Oh, I am sorry. What is the problem? What hurts?
turns.studentHint: Shamollaganingizni, boshingiz va tomog'ingiz og'riyotganini tushuntiring.

turns.characterLine: I see. You should rest. Do you have a fever?
turns.studentHint: Isitmangiz borligini ayting va dori olishingiz kerakligini so'rang.

turns.characterLine: Yes, take this medicine twice a day and drink warm tea. Get well soon!
turns.studentHint: Shifokorga maslahat uchun rahmat ayting va xayrlashing.

dialogs.title: Ordering at a Cafe
dialogs.intro: Hello! Welcome to Smart Cafe. I am Jasur, your waiter.

turns.characterLine: Hello! Welcome to our cafe. Here is the menu. What would you like to drink?
turns.studentHint: Kafeda ichimlik (masalan, suv, choy yoki sharbat) so'rang va 'iltimos' deb ayting.

turns.characterLine: Great choice! And what food would you like to eat today?
turns.studentHint: O'zingiz xohlagan taomni (masalan, pitsa, burger yoki salat) buyurtma qiling.

turns.characterLine: Here is your delicious meal! Would you like anything else, or the bill?
turns.studentHint: Rahmat ayting va hisob/narxni so'rang.

turns.characterLine: The total is 50,000 sums. Thank you for coming! Have a nice day!
turns.studentHint: Pulni bering, rahmat ayting va xayrlashing.

dialogs.title: Asking for Directions
dialogs.intro: Hello! I am Jasur. I am walking in the city center today.

turns.characterLine: Hello! You look lost. Can I help you?
turns.studentHint: Salomlashing va uzr so'rab, sizga yordam kerakligini ayting (masalan: Hello, excuse me, please help).

turns.characterLine: Of course! Where do you want to go?
turns.studentHint: Tarix muzeyi qayerdaligini so'rang (masalan: Where is the history museum?).

turns.characterLine: Go straight and turn left. It is near the big park. Is there anything else?
turns.studentHint: Piyoda borishga qancha vaqt ketishini so'rang (masalan: How many minutes to walk?).

turns.characterLine: It takes about five minutes. It is very close. Have a nice day!
turns.studentHint: Yordam uchun kattakon rahmat ayting va xayrlashing (masalan: Thank you very much, goodbye).

dialogs.title: At the School Library
dialogs.intro: Hello! Welcome to our school library. I am Miss Zilola.

turns.characterLine: Hello! Do you have a library card with you today?
turns.studentHint: Ha, kutubxona kartam bor va kitob olmoqchiman, deng.

turns.characterLine: Wonderful! What kind of book do you want to read?
turns.studentHint: Men sarguzasht va ertak kitoblarni yaxshi ko'raman, deng.

turns.characterLine: Here is a great adventure book! You must return it next Monday. Is that okay?
turns.studentHint: Ha, tushundim. Men kitobni dushanba kuni qaytaraman, deng.

turns.characterLine: Perfect! Enjoy your reading and have a wonderful day!
turns.studentHint: Kutubxonachiga katta rahmat ayting va xayrlashing.

dialogs.title: Shopping for Clothes
dialogs.intro: Hello! Welcome to our clothes shop. How can I help you today?

turns.characterLine: Hello! Welcome to our shop. What are you looking for today?
turns.studentHint: Salom bering va ko'k rangli futbolka (t-shirt) qidiryotganingizni ayting.

turns.characterLine: We have nice blue t-shirts! What size do you need?
turns.studentHint: O'lchamingiz o'rtacha (medium) ekanini ayting va kiyib ko'rsam bo'ladimi deb so'rang.

turns.characterLine: Yes, the fitting room is over there. How does it fit?
turns.studentHint: Futbolka juda mos kelganini (perfect) ayting va uning narxini so'rang.

turns.characterLine: It costs 15 dollars. Would you like to buy it?
turns.studentHint: Ha, sotib olaman deb ayting, rahmat bildiring va xayrlashing.

dialogs.title: Sports Star Interview
dialogs.intro: Hello! I'm Sara, a professional tennis player. I'm ready for your questions!

turns.characterLine: I started playing tennis when I was seven years old.
turns.studentHint: U qachon tennis o'ynay boshlaganini so'rang.

turns.characterLine: I train for four hours every day, in the morning and afternoon.
turns.studentHint: Uning kunlik mashg'ulot tartibini so'rang.

turns.characterLine: My most difficult match was the national final last year.
turns.studentHint: Eng qiyin o'yini haqida so'rang.

turns.characterLine: My advice is: practice every day and never give up.
turns.studentHint: Yosh o'yinchilarga qanday maslahat berishini so'rang.

dialogs.title: Family Responsibilities Interview
dialogs.intro: Hi! I'm your sister Dilnoza. Ask me about our home chores!

turns.characterLine: I usually wash the dishes and clean my room.
turns.studentHint: Uydagi qanday ishlarni bajarishini so'rang.

turns.characterLine: The most difficult task for me is cooking dinner.
turns.studentHint: Qaysi uy ishi eng qiyin ekanini so'rang.

turns.characterLine: We share the work — everyone helps a little every day.
turns.studentHint: Oilada ishlar qanday taqsimlanishini so'rang.

turns.characterLine: Helping at home teaches us to be responsible and kind.
turns.studentHint: Nima uchun uyda yordam berish muhimligini so'rang.

dialogs.title: Interview with a Chef
dialogs.intro: Hello! I am Chef Jasur. I love cooking delicious food.

turns.characterLine: My favorite dish is traditional palov. It is very delicious!
turns.studentHint: Uning sevimli taomi nima ekanligini so'rang. (Masalan: What is your favorite food?)

turns.characterLine: I start work early at 8 o'clock. I prepare fresh ingredients every morning.
turns.studentHint: Uning ish kuni soat nechada boshlanishini so'rang. (Masalan: What time do you start work?)

turns.characterLine: My advice is simple: practice cooking every day and always use fresh food!
turns.studentHint: Yosh oshpazlarga qanday maslahat berishini so'rang. (Masalan: What is your advice for young cooks?)

turns.characterLine: You are welcome! Thank you for the great interview. Goodbye!
turns.studentHint: Vaqti va suhbat uchun rahmat ayting va xayrlashing. (Masalan: Thank you for the interview, goodbye!)

dialogs.title: Interview with My Teacher
dialogs.intro: Hello! I am happy to answer your questions today. Let's start the interview!

turns.characterLine: I love children and sharing knowledge. I wanted to become a teacher when I was a young schoolgirl.
turns.studentHint: Nima uchun o'qituvchi bo'lishni tanlagani haqida so'rang.

turns.characterLine: My favorite subject is English because it helps children talk to people from all around the world.
turns.studentHint: Qaysi darsni o'tishni eng yaxshi ko'rishi haqida so'rang.

turns.characterLine: My wish is for my students to read many books, work hard, and always stay curious.
turns.studentHint: O'quvchilarga qanday tilagi borligini so'rang.

turns.characterLine: Thank you for these wonderful questions! Good luck with your studies!
turns.studentHint: Vaqt ajratgani uchun rahmat ayting va xayrlashing.

dialogs.title: Meet a Young Inventor
dialogs.intro: Hello! My name is Jasur. I love making new things and inventing gadgets!

turns.characterLine: Hi! I invented a small robot. It cleans the floor automatically!
turns.studentHint: Salom ber va undan nima ixtiro qilganini so'ra.

turns.characterLine: My room was always messy, so I wanted a helper! I built it last month.
turns.studentHint: Bu g'oya unga qanday kelganini so'ra.

turns.characterLine: It uses solar energy from the sun! It is very cheap and safe.
turns.studentHint: Robot qanday ishlashini yoki quvvat olishini so'ra.

turns.characterLine: Thank you so much! It was great talking to you. Goodbye!
turns.studentHint: Unga vaqti uchun rahmat ayt va omad tila.

dialogs.title: Interview with a Traveller
dialogs.intro: Hello! My name is Alex and I love travelling to different places.

turns.characterLine: I visited fifteen countries. I love travelling around the world!
turns.studentHint: Undan nechta mamlakatda bo'lganini yoki qayerga borganini so'rang.

turns.characterLine: I loved Japan the most! The mountains and cities were amazing.
turns.studentHint: Unga eng yoqqan va yodda qolgan mamlakat qaysi ekanligini so'rang.

turns.characterLine: I saw Mount Fuji and ate famous delicious food there.
turns.studentHint: U Yaponiyada nima qilgani yoki nimani ko'rgani haqida so'rang.

turns.characterLine: I will go to Egypt next month. Thank you for this interview!
turns.studentHint: Keyingi safar qayerga bormoqchi ekanini so'rang va rahmat ayting.

conversations.title: Talking with Ben
conversations.goalUz: Ben bilan tanish, qiziqishlaring va maktabing haqida gapir, oxirida unga o'zing savol ber.

nodes.line: Hi! My name is Ben. I am eleven years old and I live in London. What is your name?
nodes.hintUz: Salomlash va ismingni ayt: "Hello! My name is …"

nodes.line: Nice to meet you! Tell me, what do you like doing in your free time?
nodes.hintUz: Bo'sh vaqtingda nima qilishni yoqtirasan? "I like …" deb boshla.

nodes.line: Sorry, I did not hear you well. Do you like sport, music, books or computer games?
nodes.hintUz: Yana bir marta ayt — sport, musiqa, kitob yoki kompyuter o'yinlari.

nodes.line: That is great! I play football every Saturday. How often do you do sport?
nodes.hintUz: Qanchalik tez-tez? "I play football every day" kabi javob ber.

nodes.line: Sport is really good for our health. Do you play with your friends or alone?
nodes.hintUz: Do'stlaring bilanmi? Sababini ham qo'sh: "because …"

nodes.line: Wonderful! I play the guitar a little. What is your favourite song?
nodes.hintUz: Sevimli qo'shiging yoki qo'shiqchingni ayt.

nodes.line: Nice choice! Do you listen to music when you do your homework?
nodes.hintUz: Dars qilayotganda musiqa eshitasanmi? "Yes, because …"

nodes.line: I love books too! What book are you reading now?
nodes.hintUz: Hozir qanday kitob o'qiyapsan?

nodes.line: That sounds interesting. Do you prefer paper books or reading on a phone?
nodes.hintUz: Qog'oz kitobmi yoki telefonda? Sababini ayt.

nodes.line: I see! What game do you play the most?
nodes.hintUz: Ko'proq qaysi o'yinni o'ynaysan?

nodes.line: Interesting. How much time do you spend on the computer every day?
nodes.hintUz: Kuniga qancha vaqt? "About one hour" kabi ayt.

nodes.line: Let me ask you about last weekend. What did you do on Sunday?
nodes.hintUz: O'tgan zamonda ayt: "I went …", "I played …", "I watched …"

nodes.line: Family time is the best. What did you eat together?
nodes.hintUz: Qanday taom yedinglar?

nodes.line: That sounds fun! Was the weather good on that day?
nodes.hintUz: Ob-havo qanday edi? "It was sunny/rainy/cold".

nodes.line: A calm weekend is also nice. What did you watch or read at home?
nodes.hintUz: Uyda nima qilding?

nodes.line: Now tell me about your school. What is your favourite subject?
nodes.hintUz: Sevimli faning qaysi? "My favourite subject is …"

nodes.line: English is my favourite lesson too! Why do you like it?
nodes.hintUz: Nega yoqtirasan? "because" bilan tushuntir.

nodes.line: Wow, that is a difficult subject. Is it hard for you?
nodes.hintUz: Qiyinmi yoki osonmi? Sababini ayt.

nodes.line: Good choice. What do you usually do in that lesson?
nodes.hintUz: O'sha darsda nima qilasizlar?

nodes.line: Now it is your turn. Ask me a question about London or about me!
nodes.hintUz: Endi SEN savol ber! Masalan: "What is the weather like in London?"

nodes.line: You can ask me anything. For example: What is the weather like in London?
nodes.hintUz: Savolni shunday boshla: "What …?" yoki "Do you …?"

nodes.line: Good question! London is big and often rainy, but I love it. My favourite place is Hyde Park.
nodes.hintUz: Ben javob berdi — fikringni ayt yoki yana bir savol ber.

nodes.line: It was really nice talking to you today. Thank you and see you next time. Goodbye!
nodes.hintUz: Xayrlash: "Goodbye! It was nice to talk to you."

conversations.title: My School Day with Emma
conversations.goalUz: Ingliz tilida maktabing va darslaring haqida so'zlab ber va Emma bilan suhbatlash.

nodes.line: Hello! My name is Emma. I am 12 years old and I live in Manchester. What is your name?
nodes.hintUz: Salomlash va o'z ismingni ayt: "Hello! My name is …"

nodes.line: Nice to meet you! Let us talk about school. What is your favorite subject?
nodes.hintUz: Sevimli faning haqida ayt: "My favorite subject is …"

nodes.line: I did not hear you well. What subject do you like? Do you like Maths, English, or Art?
nodes.hintUz: Qaytadan ayt: "I like Maths", "I like English" yoki "I like Art".

nodes.line: Maths and Science are awesome! Do you like solving difficult problems in class?
nodes.hintUz: Javob ber: "Yes, I like solving problems" yoki "No, it is hard".

nodes.line: That is interesting! How many times a week do you have this lesson?
nodes.hintUz: Haftada necha marta bu dars bo'lishini ayt: "Three times a week" yoki "Every day".

nodes.line: English is great! Do you like reading English storybooks?
nodes.hintUz: Inglizcha kitob o'qishni yoqtirishingni ayt: "Yes, I read books" yoki "No, I do not".

nodes.line: That is nice! Who is your favorite teacher at school?
nodes.hintUz: Sevimli o'qituvching haqida ayt: "My favorite teacher is …"

nodes.line: Art and Music are so fun! Do you like drawing pictures or singing songs?
nodes.hintUz: Rasm chizish yoki qo'shiq kuylashingni ayt: "I like drawing pictures".

nodes.line: Cool! Do you draw pictures with your friends in class?
nodes.hintUz: Do'stlaring bilan chizishingni ayt: "Yes, with my friends" yoki "No, alone".

nodes.line: School days are full of fun! What do you usually do during the break time?
nodes.hintUz: Tanaffusda nima qilishingni ayt: "I eat a snack", "I play games" yoki "I talk with friends".

nodes.line: Eating snacks gives you energy! What food do you like to eat at school?
nodes.hintUz: Maktabda nima yeyishingni ayt: "I eat an apple" yoki "I eat bread".

nodes.line: Playing games is so exciting! Do you play football with your classmates?
nodes.hintUz: Futbol o'ynashingni ayt: "Yes, I play football" yoki "No, I play tag".

nodes.line: Talking with friends is wonderful! Do you have many close friends in your class?
nodes.hintUz: Do'stlaring ko'pligini ayt: "Yes, I have many friends".

nodes.line: Friends make every day happier! How do you usually go to school in the morning?
nodes.hintUz: Maktabga qanday borishingni ayt: "I walk to school" yoki "I do homework at home".

nodes.line: Walking or going by bicycle is nice! Do you go to school with your friends or parents?
nodes.hintUz: Kim bilan borishingni ayt: "I go with my friends" yoki "With my father".

nodes.line: Doing homework and learning new things is super important! Do you study every evening?
nodes.hintUz: Kechqurun dars qilishingni ayt: "Yes, I study every evening".

nodes.line: Now it is your turn! Do you have a question for me about my school in Manchester?
nodes.hintUz: Emmaga o'zing savol ber: "What is your favorite subject?" deb so'ra.

nodes.line: You can ask me anything! For example, ask me: 'What do you like to do at school?'
nodes.hintUz: Savol berishga harakat qil: "What do you like at school?"

nodes.line: My school in Manchester is very big and pretty! I love reading books and drawing pictures with my friends.
nodes.hintUz: Munosabat bildir: "That is great!" yoki "Very nice!" deb ayt.

nodes.line: It was really nice talking to you today! Thank you and see you next time. Goodbye!
nodes.hintUz: Xayrlash: "Goodbye! See you next time."

conversations.title: Family and Home
conversations.goalUz: Tom bilan oilang va uying haqida ingliz tilida suhbatlash.

nodes.line: Hello! My name is Tom. I am eleven years old and I live in Liverpool. What is your name?
nodes.hintUz: Salomlash va o'z ismingni ayt: "Hello! My name is ..."

nodes.line: Nice to meet you! Let's talk about family. Do you have brothers and sisters, do you live with your parents, or with your grandparents?
nodes.hintUz: Oilangda kimlar borligini ayt: "I have a brother" yoki "I live with my parents" deb javob ber.

nodes.line: I did not hear you well. Do you have brothers and sisters, parents, or grandparents at home?
nodes.hintUz: Uchta variantdan birini tanlab ayt: "I have brothers and sisters" yoki "I live with my parents".

nodes.line: That is great! I have one brother and one sister too. How many brothers or sisters do you have?
nodes.hintUz: Nechta akang, ukang yoki opang borligini ayt: "I have one brother" yoki "I have two sisters".

nodes.line: That is nice! Do you like playing games or walking together with them?
nodes.hintUz: Ular bilan nima qilishni yoqtirishingni ayt: "We play games together" yoki "We like walking".

nodes.line: That is wonderful! Parents always help us. What do your parents like doing?
nodes.hintUz: Ota-onang nima qilishni yoqtirishini ayt: "My father likes sports" yoki "My mother likes reading".

nodes.line: That sounds good! Do you like helping your parents around the house?
nodes.hintUz: Ota-onangga yordam berishingni ayt: "Yes, I help my parents every day".

nodes.line: That is super! Living with a big family is fun. Do you talk with your grandparents every day?
nodes.hintUz: Buvang yoki buving bilan gaplashishingni ayt: "Yes, I talk to my grandma every day".

nodes.line: That is so good! What is your favourite thing to do with your family?
nodes.hintUz: Oilang bilan nima qilishni yoqtirishingni ayt: "I like eating dinner with my family".

nodes.line: Now tell me about helping at home! Do you like cooking in the kitchen, cleaning your room, or helping with other things?
nodes.hintUz: Uydagilarga qanday yordam berishingni ayt: "I like cooking" yoki "I clean my room".

nodes.line: Cooking is so cool! I like making breakfast with my mum. What food do you like to cook?
nodes.hintUz: Qanday taom tayyorlashni yoqtirishingni ayt: "I like cooking pizza" yoki "I like making tea".

nodes.line: Cleaning is very good! A clean room makes you happy. When do you usually clean your room?
nodes.hintUz: Xonangni qachon tozalashingni ayt: "I clean my room on Sunday".

nodes.line: You are a good helper! Helping at home is important. What simple work do you do at home?
nodes.hintUz: Uyda qanday ish qilishingni tushuntir: "I wash the dishes" yoki "I water flowers".

nodes.line: Let's talk about rooms! Which room in your house do you like most? Is it your bedroom or the living room?
nodes.hintUz: Sevimli xonangni ayt: "I like my bedroom" yoki "My favourite room is the living room".

nodes.line: Bedrooms are great for resting! Do you read books or play games in your bedroom?
nodes.hintUz: Yotoqxonangda nima qilishingni ayt: "I read books in my bedroom".

nodes.line: The living room is very cozy! Do you watch movies with your family in the living room?
nodes.hintUz: Televizor ko'rishing yoki oilang bilan o'tirishingni ayt: "Yes, we watch movies together".

nodes.line: Now it is your turn! Please ask me a question about my family or my house. For example, ask me: 'Where do you live?'
nodes.hintUz: Tomga o'zi yoki uyi haqida savol ber: "Where do you live?" yoki "Do you have a big house?"

nodes.line: Do not be shy! You can ask me any simple question, like: 'Do you have a big house?'
nodes.hintUz: Tomga oddiy savol berishga harakat qil: "Do you have a big house?"

nodes.line: I live in a cozy house in Liverpool with my family. We have a small garden and I love my bedroom!
nodes.hintUz: Eshitganing uchun rahmat ayt: "Thank you! That is nice."

nodes.line: It was really great talking to you about family and home. Thank you and goodbye!
nodes.hintUz: Xayrlash: "Goodbye! See you next time."

conversations.title: Talking About Food
conversations.goalUz: Sofia bilan sevimli taomlaring va ovqat tayyorlash haqida ingliz tilida suhbatlash.

nodes.line: Hello! My name is Sofia. I am twelve years old and I live in Dublin. What is your name?
nodes.hintUz: Salomlash va o'z ismingni ayt: "Hello! My name is ..."

nodes.line: Nice to meet you! I love cooking with my grandma. What is your favorite food?
nodes.hintUz: Sevimli taoming haqida ayt: "I like pizza", "I like plov" yoki "I like cake" deb boshla.

nodes.line: I did not catch that. Do you like fast food like pizza, traditional food like plov, or sweets?
nodes.hintUz: Uchta variantdan birini tanlab ayt: "I like pizza", "I like plov" yoki "I like cake".

nodes.line: Fast food is so tasty! Do you often eat pizza or burgers with your friends?
nodes.hintUz: Tez-tez yeyishingni ayt: "Yes, I do" yoki "No, sometimes".

nodes.line: That sounds fun! Can you make pizza at home by yourself?
nodes.hintUz: Uyingda o'zing pitssa tayyorlay olasanmi: "Yes, I can" yoki "No, my mother makes it" deb javob ber.

nodes.line: Traditional food is wonderful! What is the name of your favorite Uzbek dish?
nodes.hintUz: Sevimli milliy taoming nomini ayt: "My favorite Uzbek dish is plov".

nodes.line: Plov looks very delicious! Do you know what ingredients are in it?
nodes.hintUz: Masalliqlarni ayt: "It has rice and meat" deb javob ber.

nodes.line: I love sweet food too! What is your favorite sweet treat?
nodes.hintUz: Sevimli shirinligingni ayt: "I love chocolate cake" yoki "I like cookies".

nodes.line: Yummy! Do you usually eat sweets after dinner or on holidays?
nodes.hintUz: Qachon shirinlik yeyishingni ayt: "I eat sweets on holidays" yoki "After dinner".

nodes.line: Food is great! Tell me, who usually cooks food in your house?
nodes.hintUz: Uyingizda kim ovqat pishirishini ayt: "My mother cooks" yoki "I cook".

nodes.line: Wow, you cook yourself? That is amazing! What simple dish can you make?
nodes.hintUz: Qaysi oddiy taomni tayyorlay olishingni ayt: "I can make salad" yoki "I make eggs".

nodes.line: That is nice! Do you help your family in the kitchen when they cook?
nodes.hintUz: Oilangga oshxonada yordam berishingni ayt: "Yes, I help my mother".

nodes.line: Eating good food is always wonderful! Do you like eating together with your family?
nodes.hintUz: Oilang bilan birga ovqatlanishni yoqtirishingni ayt: "Yes, we eat together every day".

nodes.line: Now let us talk about drinks! What do you like to drink with your food?
nodes.hintUz: Ovqat bilan nima ichishni yoqtirishingni ayt: "I drink juice" yoki "I drink water".

nodes.line: Cold juice and water are so refreshing! Do you drink juice every day?
nodes.hintUz: Har kuni sharbat ichishingni ayt: "Yes, I drink juice" yoki "No, I prefer water".

nodes.line: Nice choice! Warm drinks are great too. Do you drink them in the morning?
nodes.hintUz: Ertalab ichishingni ayt: "Yes, in the morning" yoki "No, in the evening".

nodes.line: Now it is your turn! Ask me a question about food or cooking in Ireland.
nodes.hintUz: Sofia'ga inglizcha savol ber: "What do you cook with your grandma?"

nodes.line: Do not worry! You can ask me: "What is your favorite food?" Try asking now!
nodes.hintUz: Savol berishga harakat qil: "What is your favorite food?" deb so'ra.

nodes.line: My grandma and I love baking Irish apple cake together! It is super sweet and delicious.
nodes.hintUz: Sofia'ning javobini eshitding, endi "That sounds great!" deb ayt.

nodes.line: It was really fun talking to you about food today! Thank you and goodbye!
nodes.hintUz: Xayrlash: "Goodbye! Thank you!"

conversations.title: My Town and City
conversations.goalUz: O'z shahring, undagi joylar va ob-havo haqida ingliz tilida gapirib ber.

nodes.line: Hello! My name is Olivia. I am eleven years old and I live in York. What is your name?
nodes.hintUz: Salomlash va o'z ismingni ayt: "Hello! My name is …"

nodes.line: Nice to meet you! Tell me, where do you live, and what is your town like?
nodes.hintUz: Qayerda yashashing va shahring haqida ayt. Joylar, ob-havo yoki shahring haqida: "I live in … It is …"

nodes.line: Sorry, I did not catch that. Do you want to talk about places in your town, the weather, or if it is big or small?
nodes.hintUz: Uchta variantdan birini tanlab ayt: "I want to talk about places / weather / my town."

nodes.line: Oh, places in town are so interesting! What is your favorite place in your town?
nodes.hintUz: Shahringdagi eng yoqtirgan joyingni ayt: "My favorite place is …"

nodes.line: That sounds great! Why do you like going there?
nodes.hintUz: U yerga borishni nima uchun yoqtirishingni tushuntir: "I like it because …"

nodes.line: Weather is always a good topic! What is the weather like in your town today?
nodes.hintUz: Bugungi ob-havo haqida ayt: "Today it is sunny / cold / warm."

nodes.line: I see! Which season do you like best in your town?
nodes.hintUz: O'z shahringda eng yoqtirgan faslingni ayt: "I like summer / spring best."

nodes.line: That is nice to know! Do many people live in your town?
nodes.hintUz: Shahringda odamlar ko'p yoki kamligini ayt: "Yes, many people live here." yoki "No, it is small."

nodes.line: I understand! What do you like most about your town?
nodes.hintUz: Shahringdagi eng yoqimli narsani ayt: "I like the parks / streets / people."

nodes.line: York has many old castles! What do you usually do in your town on weekends?
nodes.hintUz: Dam olish kunlari nima qilishingni ayt: sport, xarid yoki sayr haqida: "On weekends I …"

nodes.line: Sports are so fun! Do you play with your friends or family?
nodes.hintUz: Kim bilan sport o'ynashingni ayt: "I play with my friends / brother."

nodes.line: Shopping is fun too! Who do you usually go shopping with?
nodes.hintUz: Kim bilan xarid qilishga borishingni ayt: "I go with my mother / family."

nodes.line: That sounds like a relaxing day! Do you prefer going outside or staying inside?
nodes.hintUz: Tashqariga chiqishni yoqtirasanmi yoki uyda qolishnimi: "I prefer going outside / staying inside."

nodes.line: I love living in York because of its history. Do you like living in your town?
nodes.hintUz: O'z shahringda yashash yoqish-yoqmasligini ayt: "Yes, I love my town!" yoki "It is okay."

nodes.line: I am so happy to hear that! Would you like to live there forever?
nodes.hintUz: Hamma vaqt shu yerda yashashni xohlashing haqida ayt: "Yes, I want to stay here." yoki "No, I want to travel."

nodes.line: I understand! Is there another city you want to visit in the future?
nodes.hintUz: Kelajakda qaysi shaharga borishni xohlashingni ayt: "I want to visit London / Tashkent."

nodes.line: Now it is your turn! Can you ask me a question about York or my life?
nodes.hintUz: Oliviyaga York yoki uning hayoti haqida savol ber: "What is your favorite place in York?" yoki "How is the weather in York?"

nodes.line: You can ask me a simple question, like: What do you like in York?
nodes.hintUz: Sodda savol berishga harakat qil: "What do you like in York?"

nodes.line: York is a very famous old town with big castles and beautiful streets! I love walking around the city center with my friends.
nodes.hintUz: Ajoyib! Endi taassurotingni ayt va xulosa qil: "York sounds very interesting!"

nodes.line: It was really nice talking to you about our towns today! Thank you and goodbye!
nodes.hintUz: Xayrlash va rahmat ayt: "Goodbye! Thank you very much!"

conversations.title: Holidays and Travel
conversations.goalUz: Jack bilan ta'til va sayohat haqida ingliz tilida suhbatlash va uning savollariga javob ber.

nodes.line: Hi! I am Jack. I am twelve years old and I live in Bristol. What is your name?
nodes.hintUz: Salomlash va ismingni ayt: "Hello! My name is ..."

nodes.line: Nice to meet you! Summer is over. What did you do in the summer?
nodes.hintUz: Yozda nima qilganingni ayt: suzdingmi ("swimming"), qishloqqa bordingmi ("village") yoki uyda qoldingmi ("home")?

nodes.line: Sorry, I did not catch that. Did you go swimming, visit your village, or stay at home?
nodes.hintUz: Uchta variantdan birini tanlab ayt: "I went swimming", "I visited my village" yoki "I stayed at home".

nodes.line: Oh, swimming is awesome! Did you go to the beach with your family?
nodes.hintUz: Sohelda kim bilan bo'lganingni ayt: "Yes, I went with my family."

nodes.line: That sounds really fun! What was your favorite thing to do in the water?
nodes.hintUz: Suvda nima qilishni yoqtirishingni ayt: "I like swimming fast" yoki "I like playing with water".

nodes.line: That is lovely! Did you visit your grandparents in the village?
nodes.hintUz: Qishloqda buving yoki bobongni ko'rganingni ayt: "Yes, I visited my grandparents."

nodes.line: Nice! What animals or interesting things did you see in the village?
nodes.hintUz: Qishloqda ko'rgan narsalaring haqida ayt: "I saw horses and cows" yoki "I played outside".

nodes.line: Staying at home can be nice too! What games or hobbies did you enjoy?
nodes.hintUz: Uyda qanday o'yin o'ynaganingni yoki mashg'ulot qilganingni ayt: "I played games" yoki "I read books".

nodes.line: Cool! Did you spend time with your friends at home?
nodes.hintUz: Do'stlaring bilan vaqt o'tkazganingni ayt: "Yes, I played with my friends."

nodes.line: I love travelling! What is your dream city to visit in the future?
nodes.hintUz: Orzuingdagi joyni ayt: mashhur shahar ("london", "paris"), tog'lar ("mountains") yoki har qanday joy ("everywhere").

nodes.line: Wow, big cities are amazing! Why do you want to go there?
nodes.hintUz: U yerga borish sababini ayt: "Because I want to see famous places" yoki "It is beautiful".

nodes.line: Nature trips are great! Do you like hiking in the mountains?
nodes.hintUz: Tog'da sayr qilishni yoqtirishingni ayt: "Yes, I love hiking" yoki "Yes, nature is great".

nodes.line: Travelling to new places is always exciting! Who do you want to travel with?
nodes.hintUz: Kim bilan sayohat qilmoqchi ekaningni ayt: "I want to travel with my family" yoki "with my friends".

nodes.line: How do you like to travel when you go far away?
nodes.hintUz: Qanday transportda sayohat qilishni yoqtirishingni ayt: samolyot/poyezd ("plane", "train") yoki oddiy sayohat/piyoda ("walking", "traveling").

nodes.line: Taking a plane or a train is super fun! Do you like looking out the window?
nodes.hintUz: Oynadan qarashni yoqtirishingni ayt: "Yes, I love looking out the window."

nodes.line: Walking and seeing places slowly is really nice! Do you travel often?
nodes.hintUz: Tez-tez sayohat qilishingni yoki qilmasligingni ayt: "Yes, I travel every summer" yoki "No, not very often".

nodes.line: Now it is your turn! Do you have a question for me about Bristol or travel?
nodes.hintUz: Jangga savol ber: "Where do you like to travel?" yoki "Do you like Bristol?"

nodes.line: You can ask me something simple! For example: Where do you want to go?
nodes.hintUz: Jangdan o'zing xohlagan savolni so'ra: "Do you like travelling by plane?"

nodes.line: I love travelling to the beach with my family! Bristol is also a great city with a big famous bridge.
nodes.hintUz: Tushunganingni bildirish uchun "That is cool!" deb ayt.

nodes.line: It was great talking to you about holidays! Have a wonderful day. Goodbye!
nodes.hintUz: Xayrlash: "Goodbye! Thank you, Jack."
